concept: Branch Lines drew each page from its own data, and every fault its judges named was a finishing fault. Trued keeps every branch drawing and finishes each one in the diagram's own language. A line starts at a terminus and ends at a T buffer beside the way on. Stations are named in words. Every lamp has one meaning and a name under it. 'Here' is a latched cell with a steel cap on the line it meets. The phosphor is lit only where something is now or live, and on Home the green screen is the main line's first lamp: Next up hangs from tomorrow's stop as every other plan hangs its plate. It should feel like a calm, exact signal box at night where every board can be read without a key.
companions: Steel #9cc3dd (a breath more chroma than the parent's #a7c4d8) is the family's hand and the wiring: links, the family's names in Chat, their 12px rings and the 3px bar on their #1b2531 plates, and the 2px cap on every latched cell. A kind's colour lives in its ring alone, in grounded hues: terracotta #df987c for restaurants (off amber), moss #b5c87d for outings (off the second green), wheat #c3a85d for the seasons, with lemon, cyan, lilac and pink kept for activities, trips, events and shows; kind words are ink-2. Cyan #74e6f0 marks every plan stop: the fortnight, the month, the Plans list, and now a small cyan ring beside an idea in Lately added that is already on the calendar. Amber means late or needs a look and nothing else: filled for late, a half lamp for needs a look, a hollow numbered ring for a setup step still to do. Sage #86d9a6 is done and the afterglow's edge. Pewter #7a8590 rings are off by choice and dashed pewter rings are not set up or no date. The slate stays #0f1519 with #080c0d wells. #6dff9c stays exactly the signature and is lit only for now and live: the mark, the one green key, the box, 'plan', the NOW lamps and their runs, working lamps, the tubes and her newest screen.
decisions: Title: 'What’s the *plan*?' in _ask.html, still the box's <label for="text">, set as Home's largest head (Archivo 700 at width 80%, 2.5rem/1, clamp(1.9rem, 7vw, 2.5rem) on a phone, -0.012em, #ebe6da) with 'plan' in #6dff9c under E1's two layers. Kept as the tour's favoured title: the family's kitchen-table phrase, the job lit once, and nothing else on the screen glows 'plan'.

A clean sheet: build.py themes today's stylesheet with the harness's own theme.py from this palette's tokens (so the page underneath is exactly the one Branch Lines was drawn on), strips comments and spare space, and appends the lineage's readable sources (track.css, phosphor.css, relight.css, branch.css and trued.css). The sheet is 155K of 200K. Replaced rules are deleted rather than overridden: the backlit key, the shelf's box, the kids' tray, the lit setup run.

'Here' on every page is T1-32: a latched #26313a cell with a 1px top highlight and a 2px steel cap on the edge that meets the line: the bar's foot, riding its 1px #2e343b rule, with Branch Lines' small ring lamp at its middle; the top of the phone's tab bar; the left edge of the settings nav. Ideas' two view tabs, To do's Open/Done/Cancelled/All, Plans' List/Month, an open Edit and today's date on the month take the same cell with the cap along their foot.

Home, the tube is the first lamp. The greeting is the question and its box, with the ways to start stacked beside it under 'Or start with'. Next up has gone down to the main line: Coming up now draws every plan (tomorrow's Silver Falls hike was missing), the NOW lamp breathes and its lit run ends at tomorrow's stop, and that stop's plate is the green screen itself (NEXT UP, the name, '10:00 [TOMORROW]', the radar), hung on its drop as the other four hang their plates. It switches on as the page opens (E16, from a bright line). The head says '5 coming / next tomorrow 10:00', the Plans page's own words. Plates carry '13:00 in 4 days' on one line and names on two where they need it; the rail ends at a T buffer beside 'All plans'. Setup follows the week: hollow amber rings numbered 1-3, the next ring with a phosphor rim, E21 halo and 'Next step', a steel rail with nothing lit (sage only behind a step that is done), run-in bold actions and a buffer beside 'All the setup steps'. To do keeps its timetable and '4 open / 2 late', and the kids' wishes are its foot row. In Lately added, an idea already on the calendar shows its day by a cyan ring ('Sun 4 Oct'), the list's one branch to the main line.

Chat: the head is drawn as on every other page (ring, 'Vera' flush left, the lede under it). The double track is calmer: 2px rails 18px apart, the family's stop a 12px steel ring with no initial and their name in steel in the plate's head, her stop her 22px glyph screen, each time printed once across the rails on a #0b0e0c patch. Only her newest stop is lit (T1-35): that screen with E19's halo, its time in #86d9a6 with a soft halo, and its bubble with the green edge and pool; her older bubbles go matte (#111712, 1px #2e3a33) and their screens lose their bloom. The rails merge through one 45-degree pair into a lit run ending in the ring on the composer, 'your turn' beside it in 13px sage; the composer takes Home's E4 resting glow. The phone folds to one rail.

Ideas: the line from home, finished. The glass words were raised to 24 units for the station names and 20 for the mileposts (at .8), so every word on the glass reads at about 16px; the tube grew to fit. 'home' is lit and joined to the 15-minute milepost by a stub with one 45-degree jog. Only the nearest ('Pumpkin patch 18 min', under the rail) and the furthest ('Cannon Beach 2 h 45', over it) are named at rest, as SVG links to their rows with 44px hit areas. Pointing at a row lights its station and names it over the rail; the furthest's name goes out at once (opacity to 0, not .18) and comes back only after the pointed name has faded, so the tier over the rail carries one name. Names past 60% of the axis are anchored at their end. A name's own fade is 0.5s, its tick's 1.2s. On a phone the 30 min and 2 h mileposts step back so the labels never touch. The lit run goes from home to the nearest place only; :has() rules cover 40 rows.

Ideas' table: No. right-aligned in mono, then Idea (ring, name, kind word in ink-2), For, Drive in bold figures with light units and padded minutes ('2 h 05 min', right-aligned so 'min' stacks), and Way in its own column; column heads 13px sentence case. The two view tabs sit above one slate strip holding Search, Kind, Status, For and Filter, and the Kind select no longer offers 'restaurant', which the Restaurants tab already is.

Status is one lit instrument: one thin graphite case with two windows, the spend's glass at full light and a recessed #080c0d well holding the three banks, centred on the glass's height, and nothing else. Every lamp has its name under it, each bank a caption with its count ('Who answers 3 of 4', 'Keys 1 of 4', 'Connected 2 of 5'), and each lamp links to its row. One meaning per signal: lit working, a steel dot waiting, a pewter ring off by choice, a dashed ring not set up, an amber half lamp needs a look, red only stopped. The chin is one line: the tally '6 working · 1 waiting · 2 off · 4 not set up' (40px Archivo figures, each followed by its lamp) starting at the glass's text inset, and 'Change the limit' at the right before the power lamp. On a phone the tally is a 2×2 grid at 32px. The legend is printed once under the case. Who answers ends in a 45-degree turnout to a T buffer.

Status' tables: every column head is 13px sans in sentence case ('What for', 'Calls', 'US$', 'Model', 'Sent'…), right-aligned over its figures, which stay tabular mono. 'Next to be looked up' is a list of 44px rows under hairlines, no longer 52px apart.

Plans, one count: the List, the month and Home all say '5 coming / next tomorrow 10:00' (next is 'today', 'tomorrow' or 'Sun 4 Oct', the same rule on every page). The month's weeks gone by with nothing on fold into one dimmed rail row ('31 Aug – 27 Sep · nothing on'), so the eye lands on this week's NOW lamp and cyan rings. Day numbers are figures, as on the fortnight: Archivo 300 at 17px, tabular, ink-2; today's is the latched cell with its steel cap. Every week that is shown keeps its rail with a joint at each day, plans as cyan rings at their hour and today's run lit to the next plan.

To do: 'Things to do 4 / open / 2 late'; Open, Done, Cancelled and All are latched keys, then the search. On a phone the four keys are one bank of equal 44px cells, words only, and the search its own row, so 'All' is never orphaned. NOW is a 2px lit rule across the list, amber late lamps, the lit run to the next due stop, hollow steel rings after it and a dashed ring for no date; a reminder's bell and time stand in the Due cell.

Settings keeps its lamp list with the Status signals. The section pages' side nav is back to 44px rows (the inline-link padding rule no longer reaches it), each stop on its label and the latched cell with its cap on the left. The New idea form is a timetable: 13px labels right-aligned in the 8.5rem margin now stand on their field's first baseline, amber lamps at Title and Kind fill sage once valid, and the line ends at a buffer beside 'Add it'. The Wishes page joins the system: 'Wishes 0 / open / Christmas in 86 days', each kid's lists on a slate board, and each list's name and countdown on one baseline in the label step.

The afterglow shows: a row pointed at lights a 2px sage edge with 0 0 18px -10px bloom over a 6% steel wash, on in 0.12s and fading over 1.2s on an ease that holds first, so it is still there at 120ms (Ideas rows, Lately added, To do on Home and its page, the timetables, Status rows, Settings rows and the settings nav). On Ideas it also lights the row's station.

Colour separation: steel #9cc3dd sat 11.4 from the plans cyan and 4.1 from the wishes pink under protanopia, so plans moved a step to #74e6f0 and wishes to #ff94d0; the six sections now measure 13.6 typical, 5.1 deutan and 6.9 protan.

Everywhere: nothing a person reads under 13px (the foot's legal line, tags, table heads, event times, the phone's tab labels, stamps and the Status lamps' names all went to 13px), 0 targets under 44px on every rendered page, desktop and phone (and on Plans list, Family, the AI model settings and General on a phone, which the render does not shoot), no sideways scroll, every form with its csrf and once tokens, SVG geometry in presentation attributes, and reduced motion, more contrast (no halos, no bloom, the afterglow an edge only) and forced colours written for every new mark.
strengths: Home no longer reads as its parent: the question and its box stand alone in the greeting, and Next up has gone down to the main line as tomorrow's plate, so the tube and the line are one diagram, with every plan drawn and the lit run ending at the next one.

Every drawing the judges praised is kept and now reads without a key: the line from home names its nearest and furthest places at 16px and lights a pointed row's station with one name on the tier; the Status lamps have names, captions with counts and one meaning each; Chat lights only her newest stop.

One grammar on every page: a line starts at a terminus and ends at a T buffer beside the way on, 'here' is one latched cell with a steel cap, one plan count ('5 coming / next tomorrow 10:00') on Home, the List and the month, and a figure after every list page's title, Wishes included.

Colour with jobs: green is 52-68% of the coloured pixels (the parent's 90%), from steel, terracotta, moss, wheat, amber and cyan in solid things with a job, while #6dff9c stays exactly the signature and is lit only for now and live.

Typesetting: one 13px label step in sentence case (table heads included), light Archivo figures for day numbers on the fortnight and the month, DM Mono kept for times and stamps, form labels on their fields' baselines, run-in bold setup actions, and nothing under 13px; 0 targets under 44px on every page, desktop and phone.
weaknesses: Still a line-heavy design: a judge who reads rails as a subway map will find one on nearly every page.

Several values are worked out in the templates: the drive and the log scale, the short names on the glass, late on To do, the month's hours, the Settings and Status signals (read from the rows' words), and now the month's '5 coming', which the template reads from the saved plans (with Google connected it would count the saved copies, not Google's). Each belongs in views.py as a small field; the month's count and the Status signals are the most fragile.
With the tube moved to the main line, the greeting is a box and three keys: calmer, but the page's first screen has less phosphor at the top, and on a phone the tube now sits below the fold.
Coming up's other four plates are much shorter than the tube, which leaves slate under them; and plate names break onto two lines at desktop width.
The month opens on one real week under the fold of past weeks: honest for 30 September, but the grid can look nearly empty until 'Later' is pressed.
Home's Coming up is capped at five plans by the view, so its '5 coming' would undercount a busier month.
The words differ from today's by up to 29.8% on Ideas (the drive column, the glass words, the table heads, the head's figure), and Home gains 'Or start with'.
revisions: BROKEN side nav fixed: the inline-link padding rule now skips .settings-nav li and list rows, so the settings nav is 44px rows again with each stop at its label; Status' 'Next to be looked up' is 44px rows under hairlines.

Home restructured: every plan drawn (tomorrow's Silver Falls hike was missing), the lit run ends at tomorrow's stop, and Next up's tube is that stop's plate, so the tube is the line's first lamp (it switches on with E16). The head says '5 coming / next tomorrow 10:00'. The greeting keeps the question and box, with the ways to start stacked beside it. Setup now follows the week.

I made the critic's 'Next up' plate with a sage edge into the tube itself, and gave the tube a different place from the graft, which moved the line into the greeting under the tube: here the greeting is left as the question's own space.
The kids' wishes are the To do tray's foot row, so the columns end within a row of each other. Lately added shows an idea's calendar day by a cyan ring when it is planned.
Setup lights progress only where there is some: the lit gradient from step 1 is deleted (it came from branch.css as well as trued.css); the rail is steel, sage behind a done step.

One plan count: the month's head reads '5 coming / next tomorrow 10:00' like the List and Home, and the 'next' words follow one rule everywhere. I declined the '2 this month' caption: a second count beside the grid is the fault being fixed. Past empty weeks fold into one dimmed rail row. Day numbers are Archivo 300 figures, today latched.

Ideas: the far name goes out at once while another row is pointed at and returns only after it fades, pointed names past 60% anchor at their end, names are 24 units and mileposts 20 at .8 (about 16px on the glass), and the phone hides the mileposts that collided.

Status: the tally left the well for the chin, starting at the glass's text inset, with 'Change the limit' at the chin's right before the power lamp; the well holds only its banks, centred; on a phone the tally is a 2×2 grid at 32px. Cost-table heads are 13px sans sentence case, right-aligned over their figures.

Phone and form: To do's four keys are a 4-column bank of 44px word-only cells with the search on the next row; the New idea form's margin labels stand on their fields' first baselines. Lately added rows put the day and whom under the name on a phone.

Wishes: the head figure 'Wishes 0 / open / Christmas in 86 days', each kid's lists on a slate board, and the countdown set as a 13px label on the list name's baseline instead of a chip that pushed it down.
